steps.name: Student logs in with admission number and PIN
Student updates preferred stream and career interests
Student browses career information filtered by stream
Student views career details and saves the career
Student submits a career guidance request
Student sees the request in My chats
Student opens the Get help now screen
Counsellor logs in with email and password
Counsellor sees the career request in the inbox; anonymous case shows no name
Counsellor replies to the career guidance request
Counsellor creates a student account and receives a PIN
Student receives the counsellor reply and confirmed session
